## History

Jordan was the son of Mr. Gray and went to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) one winter for work, where he fell in love with Hester Murray. After marrying Hester, he was given a farm by his father and lived with her in a small house in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for four years. Following Hester's death, Jordan sold the farm and returned to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston).

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P54](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0054)_
